name: Austria
summary: Possession is a crime under the SMG, but personal-use cases go to health authorities and prosecutors must suspend them ("Therapie statt Strafe"). The NPS law punishes only supply. Drug checking is legal.
callingForHelp: Ambulance (144) staff are bound by confidentiality and police are not routinely informed; personal-use offences go to health authorities first. No Good Samaritan law.
drugChecking: Legal and available: checkit! (Vienna, fixed site and events) and Z6 drug checking (Innsbruck).

npsv.title: NPS Ordinance (NPSV) with generic substance groups

parlN2O.title: Parliament motion 988/A(E) on nitrous oxide misuse (10 July 2026)

jugendschutz.title: Burgenland youth-protection amendment 2019 (spirits from 18, harmonised across states)

lsd.note: Suchtgift (SV Annex V). Possession is a crime (up to 6 months if for own use), but personal-use cases must be suspended (§35 SMG).

mushrooms.note: Supplying psilocybin mushrooms or growing them for intoxication is a crime (§27(1)3 SMG); personal-use cases are suspended. Spores/grow kits are sold.

dmt.note: Suchtgift (SV Annex V), so ayahuasca is illegal. Personal-use cases are suspended (§35 SMG).

mescaline.note: Mescaline is a Suchtgift (SV Annex V). Mescaline cacti (San Pedro, peyote) are not listed and are sold as ornamentals.

dox.note: DOB, DOC and DOM are Suchtgifte (SV); other analogues fall under the NPS phenethylamine group (supply is a crime).

nbomes.note: 25B-, 25C- and 25I-NBOMe are Suchtgifte (SV); other NBOMes fall under NPS generic groups (supply a crime, possession not).

2c-x.note: 2C-B, 2C-I and other common 2C-x are Suchtgifte (SV); others fall under the NPS phenethylamine group (supply up to 2 years).

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7 are Suchtgifte (SV); other 2C-T-x fall under the NPS phenethylamine group.

5-meo-xxt.note: Not Suchtgifte, but covered by the NPS tryptamine group: supply for gain is a crime (up to 2 years); possession is not punished but is confiscated.

cannabis.note: Possession is a crime, but personal-use cases go to health authorities and prosecutors must suspend them (1–2 year probation). Low-THC CBD sold.

ketamine.note: Not a Suchtmittel; prescription-only medicine. Supplying it without authorisation breaches medicines law; possession is not an SMG offence.

mxe.note: Listed in the SV (treated as Suchtgift); possession is a crime, personal-use cases suspended.

dxm.note: Cough medicines with ≤15 mg DXM per dose are sold in pharmacies without prescription; higher doses need one. Not a Suchtmittel.

nitrous.note: Not controlled under SMG or NPSG; no federal sales ban as of mid-2026 (parliament motions pending). Food/technical sale and possession legal.

amphetamines.note: Amphetamine and methamphetamine are Suchtgifte: possession is a crime, personal-use cases suspended. ADHD drugs on prescription.

mdma.note: Suchtgift (SV Annex V). Possession is a crime; personal-use cases are suspended (§35 SMG).

cocaine.note: Suchtgift. Possession is a crime (§27 SMG); personal-use cases suspended; dealing above threshold amounts is punished much more severely.

caffeine.note: Not a controlled substance; sold freely.

alcohol.note: Beer and wine from 16; spirits and spirit-based mixed drinks from 18 (state youth-protection laws, harmonised in 2019).

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is a Suchtgift (SV Annex V). GBL and 1,4-BD are listed NPS (NPSV): supplying them for intoxication is a crime, possession is not.

opioids.note: Heroin is banned; morphine, oxycodone and fentanyl are Suchtgifte on narcotics prescription; possession without one is a crime.

tramadol.note: Prescription medicine. Tramadol preparations are listed as Suchtgift (SV Annex III), so possession without prescription is an SMG offence.

benzodiazepines.note: Psychotropic substances (PV): prescription-only; possession without prescription is an offence under the SMG.

maois.note: Prescription-only (e.g. moclobemide). Harmala alkaloids are not listed, but ayahuasca is illegal because DMT is a Suchtgift.
